title: Alur Approval Multilevel (Manajemen): Pusat Persetujuan Bertingkat Lintas Dokumen (PO/Dispatch/Cuti/Expense/dll)
description: Alur bisnis kritikal 'command center' persetujuan untuk manajemen. Satu mesin approval bertingkat (sequential multi-level) melayani BANYAK tipe dokumen: leave (cuti), overtime (lembur), expense (klaim biaya), purchase_order (PO), salary_adjustment (penyesuaian gaji), material_return (retur material), resignation (pengunduran diri), dan asset_purchase (pembelian aset). Rantai (chain) yang dipakai ditentukan otomatis berdasar type + kondisi ambang (amount/days): mis. PO >= 5jt -> 3 level (Admin Purchasing -> Manajer -> Owner), Cuti < 3 hari -> 1 level (Manajer). Requester submit -> Level 1 pending, level lain waiting -> approver Level 1 approve -> pindah Level 2 -> ... -> level terakhir approve -> APPROVED. Reject di level mana pun MENGGAGALKAN request (cascade: level sisa jadi skipped). Requester dapat cancel selama masih pending. Admin/Owner mengelola konfigurasi chain (CRUD + seed default). Modul menyediakan inbox 'Perlu Tindakan' per user (berdasar peran di level aktif), daftar 'Semua Request', dan ringkasan (widget summary). Guardrail: submit tanpa chain cocok ditolak (400), approve/reject request yang sudah selesai ditolak (400), cancel request non-pending ditolak (400), dan konfigurasi chain hanya untuk admin/owner (403).
happy_path_steps: Setup: pastikan chain default ter-seed (idempotent) -> approval_chains terisi 11 chain baku
Submit request (type + ref_code + meta.amount/days) -> chain dipilih otomatis; status=pending, current_level=1, level lain waiting; nomor id
Approve Level 1 -> current_level=2, level 1 approved, level 2 pending (sequential)
Approve Level 2 -> current_level=3, level 2 approved, level 3 pending
Approve Level terakhir -> status=approved + completed_at (semua level approved)
Jalur reject: approve L1 lalu reject L2 -> status=rejected, level sisa=skipped (cascade)
Jalur cancel: requester cancel saat pending -> status=cancelled
Konfigurasi chain: create/update/delete (soft) chain oleh admin/owner
Inbox: GET pending (per peran di level aktif) + GET summary (total_pending, my_pending_count, approved_today, by_type)
guardrails: Create/Update/Delete chain oleh non-admin (mis. role hr) -> 403
verification: backend API POC ALL PASS (tests/flow_manajemen_approval_multilevel_test.py: seed 11 chain; routing kondisi leave days>=3->3 level & days<3->1 level; PO 12jt 3-level approve L1->L2->L3->approved; reject cascade L2->rejected+L3 skipped; cancel->cancelled; chain CRUD create/update/soft-delete; guard no-chain 400, approve-after-done 400, cancel-after-cancel 400, non-admin create-chain 403; pending+summary 200); audit_testids.py approval-multilevel LULUS 0 FAIL (15 testid statik unik; A4 WARN = false-positive parsing arrow-function). DB pristine setelah cleanup (approval_requests=0; chain default dipertahankan).
notes_qa: Observasi LOW (code smell, non-blocking): services/approval_chain_service.py process_action() memiliki blok logika terduplikasi (baris ~302-389). Efeknya benign karena blok kedua membaca ulang doc['current_level'] in-memory yang TIDAK berubah, sehingga menghasilkan transisi identik (tidak melompati level). Diverifikasi via POC: approve tepat maju satu level, reject cascade benar. Direkomendasikan refactor (hapus duplikasi) di sesi backend terpisah. Frontend MultiLevelApprovalModule.jsx ditambah 15 data-testid (tabs/filter/refresh/seed/card actions/detail modal) untuk testability E2E.
